content.text: Near Loch Lomond, a six-vehicle collision has claimed the life of a 71-year-old biker riding a Harley Davidson equipped with a sidecar.
Sgt Luke Jenkins: If you were driving in the area and have a dash cam fitted, please review your footage as you may have captured something that could assist with our investigation.
The road has been shut for hours after the crash involving three lorries, two cars and a van at about 11:30 BST and is not expected to reopen between junctions one and 25 until 02:30 at the earliest.
